hotspots.title: AfD’s poll surge and leadership ambitions
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to gain traction in polls, particularly in Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt, where it leads with over 40%. The party's ambitions to govern alone and its controversial proposals, such as home schooling and mass deportations, have sparked intense debate and warnings from experts about democratic erosion.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the party's rapid rise, its potential to reshape German politics, and the alarmist framing around its policies and rhetoric.

hotspots.title: Ben-Gvir’s flotilla video sparks global outrage
hotspots.blurb: Israeli far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir released a video taunting detained Gaza-bound flotilla activists, including Italians, which sparked international condemnation. The incident has strained Israel's relations with Italy and other European nations, prompting calls for apologies and diplomatic repercussions.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the moral outrage over the treatment of activists, the diplomatic fallout, and the polarized contention around Israel's far-right government.
